notes: Archive numbers are 100*X + 10*Y + Z for the NARC at a/X/Y/Z. A member override is written to a/X/Y/Z/<index>.
Offsets are bytes from the start of the record. Integers are little-endian. A 'bits' field reads width bits starting at bit (LSB = 0) of the size-byte little-endian word at offset.
'repeat' means the field occurs count times at stride bytes; the n-th copy is at offset + n * stride and is named name1..nameN in a form.
'when' makes a field apply only while the named field of the same record equals the value.
'confidence' is 'verified' (code or data confirmed) or 'inferred' (see docs/game-data-map.md).
Enums with a 'source' point at a text bank in archive 2 (a/0/0/2); the entry index equals the enum value. No game text is stored here.
Tables listed under arm9Tables are not in a NARC; they live in the ARM9 image.

graphics.label: Pokemon battle sprites
graphics.mapping: block = 20 * blockIndex; blockIndex = species id; 650 = egg, 651 = Manaphy egg; forms with their own sprite: 652 + formSpriteIndex + form - 1 (formSpriteShared forms use the species block and only change the palette member); member = block + role offset

roles.note: small 2D tile sheet (12x12 tiles); +1 holds the female variant when its member is non-empty
battle bitmap, 16384 bytes of 4bpp tiles (the 'texture' member the MCSS renderer loads); +3 holds the female variant
cell header record, no NITRO magic
normal palette (16 colors); palette-only forms use member 14253 + (formSpriteIndex + form - 1) * 2 + shiny

graphics.label: Trainer battle sprites (front)
graphics.mapping: block = 8 * graphic; graphic = TrainerGraIndexTable[trainerClass] (106-byte table in the ARM9 image at 0x020A023C) for classes up to 0x69; 95 graphics

graphics.label: Trainer battle sprites (back, player characters)
graphics.mapping: block = 8 * graphic, 6 graphics selected directly by id (flag bit set); same eight roles as the front archive

graphics.label: Pokemon icons (party and box)
graphics.mapping: member 0 = palette (3 sub-palettes of 16 colors); 1..6 = shared cell and animation files; icon tiles: 7 + 2 * n, n = species id, 650 egg, 651 Manaphy egg, forms with own icon (formSpriteIndex + form - 1) + 652; the odd member after each icon holds the female variant when non-empty (else size 0); sub-palette choice comes from a nibble table in the ARM9 image (0x0209E474): low nibble male, high nibble female, index = species (egg 650/651; form index formSpriteIndex + form + 651)

roles.note: icon tiles for species 0, 1024 bytes = two 32x32 4bpp frames; species n at 7 + 2n

graphics.label: Item icons (bag)
graphics.mapping: item id -> (tileMember, paletteMember) from the u16 pair table item_gfx_member in the ARM9 image (0x0209EB6C, 627 entries); item 0 uses (1001, 1002); members 0 and 1 are the shared animation and cell bank

roles.note: tile member: 512 bytes of 4bpp = one 32x32 icon
palette member (tile member + 1 for the first items)

graphics.label: Overworld object parameters
graphics.mapping: single member: 4-byte header (u16 count = 799) then 799 records of 28 bytes; record = object code table index

fields.name: resource

graphics.label: Overworld object models and textures
graphics.mapping: members are BMD0 models, BTX0 textures and animation files referenced by the resource ids of a/0/4/8; no pixel-level editor target (3D)

graphics.label: Map chunks (3D terrain, buildings, per-tile attributes)
graphics.mapping: member = chunk id taken from the map matrix (a/0/0/9) cells; each member is a small size-table wrapper (tags WB, GC, NG, RD) around a BMD0 model followed by a width x height grid of 8-byte tile records (u16 surface, u16 height index, u32 attribute: terrain id in bits 0..15, flags in bits 16..31)

graphics.label: Map matrix
graphics.mapping: member = matrixId from the zone header; header u16 mode, u16 pad, u16 width, u16 height (width and height at most 30, product at most 900), then width*height u32 chunk ids (member of a/0/0/8, 0xFFFFFFFF = empty), then, when mode is 1, width*height u32 zone ids (member 0 is 6272 = 8 + 783 * 8 bytes)

graphics.label: Map area textures
graphics.mapping: BTX0 texture sets; member = texSetId of the area record (a/0/1/3), equal to the record index in 280 of 282 records [inferred]

sounds.label: Music (BGM)
sounds.mapping: SDAT sequence numbers 1000..1178 (names SEQ_BGM_* in the SYMB block); the zone header holds four of these per zone, one per season

sounds.label: Sound effects (SE)

sounds.label: Pokemon cries
sounds.mapping: wave archive (SWAR) number = cry index: species id 1..649; 650 = Sky Forme Shaymin (species 492 form 1); each archive holds one PCM or ADPCM wave; wave archive names are WAVE_ARC_PV### (first 494) and WAVE_ARC_PMWB_### (remaining); per-species playback parameters in a/1/9/4 (652 x 4 bytes: u16 rate, u8 volume 97..127, u8 pad); Chatot (441) can play a recorded sample instead

textBanks.note: type names, index = type id (17 entries, 0 Normal ... 16 Dark)
trainer class names, index = class id
place names, zone header placeNameId (10 bits) indexes this bank
Pokedex flavor text (banks 235..243 are the per-version and per-language copies)
species category text, for example 'Seed Pokemon' style; banks 260..267 per language
height strings (245..252 per unit and language)
weight strings (269..275 per unit and language)

trainerLocation.note: A trainer NPC is an NPC record of the zone event data (a/1/2/5) whose eventId equals scriptBase + trainer id; scriptBaseSecond + trainer id marks the second member of a pair. The zone owning the event file is the zone whose header eventDataId is that member; its place name is entry placeNameId (bits 0-9 of the u16 at 0x1A) of text bank 89 of archive 2. Scripted battles (gym leaders, rivals) have literal trainer ids in script opcodes 133 (single), 134 (multi, first operand is the ally) and 148 (with a Pokemon) of the zone script member (zone header scriptArcId in a/0/5/7); entry k of a zone script is script id k + 1. Verified in code (event_trainer.c:57-69, event_trainer_eye.c:683, scrcmd_trainer_audio_item.c:331-497, script_sys.c:624).
